there is power, power, wonder-working power
in the precious blood of the Lamb.

hymns.title: There Is Sunshine In My Soul

verses.verse_content:
There is sunshine in my soul today,
More glorious and bright
Than glows in any earthly sky,
For Jesus is my light.

There is music in my soul today,
A carol to my King,
And Jesus, listening, can hear
The songs I cannot sing.

There is springtime in my soul today,
For when the Lord is near,
The dove of peace sings in my heart,
The flowers of grace appear.

content.chorus:
O there’s sunshine, blessed sunshine,
When the peaceful happy moments roll:
When Jesus shows His smiling face,
There is sunshine in the soul.

verses.verse_content:
That Rock's a cross, its arms outspread,
Celestial glory bathes its head;
To its firm base my all I bring,
And to the cross of Ages cling.

content.chorus:
Some build their hopes on the ever-drifting sand,
Some on their fame or their treasure or their land;
Mine’s on a Rock that forever will stand,
Jesus, the "Rock of Ages."

verses.verse_content:
There’s a fountain free, ’tis for you and me:
Let us haste, oh, haste to its brink;
’Tis the fount of love from the Source above,
And He bids us all freely drink.

There’s a living stream, with a crystal gleam,
From the throne of life now it flows;
While the waters roll let the weary soul
Hear the call that forth freely goes.

There's a living well and its waters swell,
And eternal life they can give;
And we joyful sing, ever spring, oh, spring,
As we haste to drink and to live.

content.chorus:
Will you come to the fountain free?
Will you come? 'tis for you and me;
Thirsty soul, hear the welcome call,
’Tis a fountain open'd for all.

verses.verse_content:
There's a great day coming,
A great day coming,
There's a great day coming by and by,
When the saints and the sinners shall
be parted right and left,
Are you ready for that day to come?

There's a bright day coming,
A bright day coming,
There's a bright day coming by and by,
But its brightness shall only come
to them that love the Lord,
Are you ready for that day to come?

content.chorus:
Are you ready? Are you ready?
Are you ready for the judgment day?
Are you ready? Are you ready?
for the judgment day?

hymns.title: There's A Rainbow In The Cloud

verses.verse_content:
Be not weary or cast down,
When the heavens seem to frown,
There’s a rainbow on the cloud for you!
‘Tis an arch of promise bright,
Earnest of unfading light,
Pouring from a sky of radiant blue.

He whose word rebuked the storm,
Now is able to perform
Ev’ry word He whispers to your heart;
Wholly lean upon Him, then,
For the sun will shine again,
And the shadows evermore depart.

content.chorus:
There’s a rainbow on the cloud for you,
There’s a promise that is sure and true;
Yes, the storm will pass away,
There will dawn a brighter day,
There’s a rainbow on the cloud for you.

hymns.title: There's A Royal Banner {The Banner Of The Cross}

verses.verse_content:
There's a royal banner given for display
To the soldiers of the King;
As an ensign fair we lift it up today,
While as ransomed ones we sing.

Though the foe may rage and gather as the flood,
Let the standard be displayed;
And beneath its folds, as soldiers of the Lord,
For the truth be not dismayed!

Over land and sea, wherever man may dwell,
Make the glorious tidings known;
Of the crimson banner now the story tell,
While the Lord shall claim His own!

When the glory dawns 'tis drawing very near--
It is hast'ning day by day;
Then before our King the foe shall disappear,
And the cross the world shall sway!

content.chorus:
Marching on, marching on,
For Christ count ev'rything but loss!
And to crown Him King,
toil and sing 'Neath the banner of the cross!

verses.verse_content:
This is my Father's world,
And to my listening ears
All nature sings, and round me rings
The music of the spheres.
This is my Father's world:
I rest me in the thought
Of rocks and trees, of skies and seas--
His hand the wonders wrought.

This is my Father's world:
The birds their carols raise,
The morning light, the lily white,
Declare their Maker's praise.
This is my Father's world:
He shines in all that's fair;
In the rustling grass I hear Him pass,
He speaks to me everywhere.

This is my Father's world:
O let me ne'er forget
That though the wrong seems oft so strong,
God is the Ruler yet.
This is my Father's world:
Why should my heart be sad?
The Lord is King: let the heavens ring!
God reigns; let earth be glad!

hymns.title: This World Is Not My Home

verses.verse_content:
This world is not my home, I'm just a passing through
My treasures are laid up somewhere beyond the blue;
The angels beckon me from heaven's open door,
And I can't feel at home in this world anymore.

They're all expecting me, and that's one thing I know,
My Savior pardoned me and now I onward go;
I know He'll take me thro' tho' I am weak and poor,
And I can't feel at home in this world anymore.

I have a loving Savior up in glory-land,
I don't expect to stop until I with Him stand,
He's waiting now for me in heaven's open door,
And I can't feel at home in this world anymore.

Just up in glory-land we'll live eternally,
The saints on every hand are shouting victory,
Their songs of sweetest praise drift back from heaven's shore,
And I can't feel at home in this world anymore.

content.chorus:
O Lord, you know I have no friend like you,
If heaven's not my home, then Lord what will I do?
The angels beckon me from heaven's open door,
And I can't feel at home in this world anymore.

verses.verse_content:
You are the way; thro' you alone
can we the Father find;
in you, O Christ, has God revealed
his heart and will and mind.

You are the truth; your Word alone
true wisdom can impart;
you only can inform the mind
and purify the heart.

You are the life; the empty tomb
proclaims your conqu'ring arm,
and those who put their trust in you
nor death nor hell shall harm.

Amid the trials which I meet,
Amid the thorns that pierce my feet,
One thought remains supremely sweet:
Thou thinkest, Lord, of me!

The cares of life come thronging fast,
Upon my soul their shadow cast;
Their gloom reminds my heart at last:
Thou thinkest, Lord, of me!

content.chorus:
Thou thinkest, Lord, of me,
Thou thinkest, Lord, of me!
What need I fear when Thou art near,
And thinkest, Lord, of me?

hymns.title: Though Your Sins Be As Scarlet

verses.verse_content:
Hear the voice that entreats you,
O return ye unto God!
Hear the voice that entreats you,
O return ye unto God!
He is of great compassion,
And of wondrous love;
Hear the voice that entreats you,
Hear the voice that entreats you,
O return ye unto God!
O return ye unto God!

Alas! and did my Savior bleed,
and did my Sovereign die!
Would he devote that sacred head
for sinners such as I?

Was it for crimes that I have done,
he groaned upon the tree?
Amazing pity! Grace unknown!
And love beyond degree!

Well might the sun in darkness hide,
and shut its glories in,
when God, the mighty maker, died
for his own creature's sin.

Thus might I hide my blushing face
while his dear cross appears;
dissolve my heart in thankfulness,
and melt mine eyes to tears.

But drops of tears can ne'er repay
the debt of love I owe.
Here, Lord, I give myself away;
'tis all that I can do.

hymns.title: Tis Midnight And On Olive's Brow

verses.verse_content:
’Tis midnight, and on Olive’s brow
the star is dimmed that lately shone;
’tis midnight; in the garden now
the suff'ring Savior prays alone.

’Tis midnight, and, from all removed,
Emmanuel wrestles lone with fears:
e’en the disciple that He loved
heeds not his Master’s grief and tears.

’Tis midnight, and, for others’ guilt,
the Man of Sorrows weeps in blood;
yet He that hath in anguish knelt
is not forsaken by His God.

hymns.title: Tis So Sweet To Trust In Jesus

verses.verse_content:
'Tis so sweet to trust in Jesus,
and to take him at his word;
just to rest upon his promise,
and to know, "Thus saith the Lord."

O how sweet to trust in Jesus,
just to trust his cleansing blood;
and in simple faith to plunge me
neath the healing, cleansing flood!

Yes, 'tis sweet to trust in Jesus,
just from sin and self to cease;
just from Jesus simply taking
life and rest, and joy and peace.

content.chorus:
Jesus, Jesus, how I trust him!
How I've proved him o'er and o'er!
Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus!
O for grace to trust him more!

hymns.title: Tis The Blessed Hour Of Prayer

verses.verse_content:
‘Tis the blessed hour of prayer, when our hearts lowly bend,
And we gather to Jesus, our Savior and Friend;
If we come to Him in faith, His protection to share,
What a balm for the weary! O how sweet to be there!

Refrain
Blessed hour of prayer, Blessed hour of prayer,
What a balm for the weary! O how sweet to be there!

‘Tis the blessed hour of prayer, when the Savior draws near,
With a tender compassion His children to hear;
When He tells us we may cast at His feet every care,
What a balm for the weary! O how sweet to be there!

To be like Jesus, To be like Jesus.
All I ask, to be like Him.
All thru life's journey from earth to glory,
All I ask, to be like Him.

To love like Jesus, to love like Jesus.
All I ask, to love like Him.
All thru life's journey from earth to glory,
All I ask, to love like Him.

To pray like Jesus, to pray like Jesus.
All I ask, to pray like Him.
All thru life's journey from earth to glory,
All I ask, to pray like Him.

hymns.title: To Canaan's Land I'm On My Way {Where The Soul Never Dies}

verses.verse_content:
To Canaan’s land I’m on my way,
Where the soul never dies;
My darkest night will turn to day,
Where the soul never dies.

A rose is blooming there for me,
Where the soul never dies;
And I will spend eternity,
Where the soul never dies.

A love-light beams across the foam,
Where the soul never dies;
It shines to light the shores of home,
Where the soul never dies.

My life will end in deathless sleep,
Where the soul never dies;
And everlasting joys I’ll reap,
Where the soul of man never dies.

content.chorus:
No sad farewells, no tear-dimmed eyes;
Where all is love, and the soul never dies.

verses.verse_content:
To Christ be loyal and be true;
His banner be unfurled,
And borne aloft till is secured
The conquest of the world.

To Christ be loyal and be true;
He needs brave volunteers
To stand against the pow'rs of sin,
Moved not by frowns or fears.

To Christ be loyal and be true;
In noble service prove
Your faith or your fidelity,
The fervor of your love.

content.chorus:
To Christ, the Lord, be true,
For He will go with you,
And help you all your conflicts thro';
To Christ, the Lord, be true.

verses.verse_content:
To God be the glory, great things He hath done,
so loved He the world that He gave us His Son,
who yielded His life an atonement for sin,
and opened the life-gate that all may go in.

O perfect redemption, the purchase of blood,
to ev'ry believer the promise of God;
the vilest offender who truly believes,
that moment from Jesus a pardon receives.

content.chorus:
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord,
let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord,
let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father through Jesus the Son,
and give Him the glory, great things He hath done.

hymns.title: To Love Some One More Dearly (My Task)

verses.verse_content:
To love someone more dearly ev’ry day,
To help a wand’ring child to find his way,
To ponder o’er a noble tho’t and pray,
And smile when evening falls,
And smile when evening falls,
This is my task.

To follow truth as blind men long for light,
To do my best from dawn of day till night,
To keep my heart fit for His holy sight,
And answer when He calls,
And answer when He calls,
This is my task.

What Child is this, who, laid to rest,
On Mary's lap is sleeping?
Whom angels greet with anthems sweet,
While shepherds watch are keeping?

Why lies He in such mean estate,
Where ox and ass are feeding?
Good Christian, fear: for sinners here
The silent Word is pleading.

So bring Him incense, gold, and myrrh,
Come, peasant, king to own Him.
The King of kings salvation brings;
Let loving hearts enthrone Him.

content.chorus:
This, this is Christ, the King,
Whom shepherds guard and angels sing:
Haste, haste to bring Him laud,
The Babe, the Son of Mary!

verses.verse_content:
To the work! to the work! we are servants of God,
Let us follow the path that our Master has trod;
With the balm of His counsel our strength to renew,
Let us do with our might what our hands find to do.

content.chorus:
Toiling on, toiling on,
Toiling on, toiling on:
Let us hope, let us watch,
And labor till the Master comes.

verses.verse_content:
True-hearted, whole-hearted, faithful and loyal,
King of our lives, by Thy grace we will be;
Under the standard exalted and royal,
Strong in Thy strength we will battle for Thee.

True-hearted, whole-hearted, fullest allegiance
Yielding henceforth to our glorious King;
Valiant endeavor and loving obedience,
Freely and joyously now would we bring. (Chorus)

True-hearted, whole-hearted, Savior all-glorious!
Take Thy great power and reign Thou alone,
Over our wills and affections victorious,
Freely surrendered and wholly Thine own. (Chorus)

content.chorus:
Peal out the watchword! silence it never!
Song of our spirits, rejoicing and free
Peal out the watchword! loyal forever,
King of our lives, by Thy grace we will be.

verses.verse_content:
When we walk with the Lord
in the light of his word,
what a glory he sheds on our way!
While we do his good will,
he abides with us still,
and with all who will trust and obey.

Not a burden we bear,
not a sorrow we share,
but our toil he doth richly repay;
not a grief or a loss,
not a frown or a cross,
but is blest if we trust and obey.

content.chorus:
Trust and obey, 
for there's no other way
to be happy in Jesus, 
but to trust and obey.

verses.verse_content:
O soul, are you weary and troubled?
No light in the darkness you see?
There’s light for a look at the Savior,
And life more abundant and free!

Thro' death into life everlasting,
He passed, and we follow Him there;
O’er us sin no more hath dominion--
For more than conqu’rors we are!

content.chorus:
Turn your eyes upon Jesus,
Look full in His wonderful face,
And the things of earth will grow strangely dim,
In the light of His glory and grace.

verses.verse_content:
Under His wings I am safely abiding.
Though the night deepens and tempests are wild,
still I can trust Him; I know He will keep me.
He has redeemed me, and I am His child.

Under His wings, what a refuge in sorrow!
How the heart yearningly turns to His rest!
Often when earth has no balm for my healing,
there I find comfort, and there I am blest.

content.chorus:
Under His wings, under His wings,
who from His love can sever?
Under His wings my soul shall abide,
safely abide forever.

verses.verse_content:
Unto the hills around do I lift up
My longing eyes;
O whence for me shall my salvation come,
From whence arise?
From God the Lord doth come my certain aid,
From God the Lord who heaven and earth hath made.

He will not suffer that thy foot be moved:
Safe shalt thou be.
No careless slumber shall His eyelids close,
Who keepeth thee.
Behold our God the Lord, He slumbereth ne'er,
Who keepeth Israel in His holy care.

Master, on Calv’ry we see Thee in anguish,
Unto Thy cross we by faith would draw nigh;
Wounded and thorn-crowned in pain dost Thou languish,
Suff’ring for sinners uplifted to die,
For sinners uplifted to die.

Hear we Thy message of mercy so tender,
“Father, forgive they know not what they do;”
Can we but yield in a fullest surrender,
Unto a love so unfathomed, so true?
To love so unfathomed, so true?

content.chorus:
O vision of Calvary, vision so blest,
His love and compassion reveal;
For He came that the weary might ever find rest,
And He came broken-hearted to heal.
In His cross would we hope,
We would glory for aye,
In its light we would ever abide,
For the Saviour who suffered that we might be free,
To His home everlasting will guide.

verses.verse_content:
Walk beside me, O my Savior,
While life’s morning sky is bright;
Grant me now thy loving favor,
Flood my path with heav’nly light
Whether good or ill betide me,
Whether skies be dark or clear,
Ever stay so close beside me
I may know and feel thee near.

When the noontide’s glowing splendor
Brings its weight of toil and care,
May thy love, so pure and tender,
All my heavy burdens bear!
In a weary land, provide me
Sheltering rock and cooling spring;
When the tempest rages, hide me
Underneath thy folded wing.

content.chorus:
Blessed Savior, walk with me,
Take away all anxious fear;
Ever stay so close beside me,
I may know and feel thee near.

verses.verse_content:
All ye saints of light proclaim,
Jesus, the Light of the world;
Life and mercy in His name,
Jesus, the Light of the world.

Hear the Saviour’s earnest call,
Jesus, the Light of the world;
Send the gospel truth to all,
Jesus, the Light of the world.

Why not seek Him then today,
Jesus, the Light of the world;
Go with truth the narrow way,
Jesus, the Light of the world.

content.chorus:
We’ll walk in the light, beautiful light,
Come where the dew-drops of mercy are bright;
Shine all around us by day and by night,
Jesus, the Light of the world.

verses.verse_content:
I want Jesus to walk with me.
I want Jesus to walk with me.
All along my pilgrim journey,
I want Jesus to walk with me.

In my trials, walk with me.
In my trials, walk with me.
When the shades of life are falling,
I want Jesus to walk with me.

In my sorrows, walk with me.
In my sorrows, walk with me.
When my heart within is aching.
I want Jesus to walk with me.

Walking alone at eve and viewing the skies afar,
Bidding the darkness come to welcome each silver star;
I have a great delight in the wonderful scenes above,
God in His pow;r and might is showing His truth and love.

Sitting alone at eve and dreaming the hours away,
Watching the shadows falling now at the close of day;
God in His mercy comes with His Word He is drawing near,
Spreading His love and truth around me and ev'rywhere.

content.chorus:
O! for a home with God,
a place in His courts to rest.
Sure in a safe abode with Jesus and the blest;
Rest for a weary soul once redeemed by the Savior’s love,
Where I’ll be pure and whole and live with my God above!

verses.verse_content:
Principalities and powers,
mustering their unseen array,
wait for thy unguarded hours;
'watch and pray.'

Hear, above all, hear thy Lord,
him thou lovest to obey;
hide within thy heart his word,
'watch and pray.'

Low at his feet lay thy burden of carefulness:
high on his heart he will bear it for thee,
comfort thy sorrows, and answer thy prayerfulness,
guiding thy steps as may best for thee be.

Fear not to enter his courts in the slenderness
of the poor wealth thou wouldst reckon as thine:
truth in its beauty, and love in its tenderness,
these are the offerings to lay on his shrine.

These, though we bring them in trembling and fearfulness,
he will accept for the name that is dear;
mornings of joy give for evenings of tearfulness,
trust for our trembling and hope for our fear.

Will your anchor hold in the storms of life,
when the clouds unfold their wings of strife?
When the strong tides lift, and the cables strain,
will your anchor drift, or firm remain?

It is safely moored; 'twill the storm withstand,
for 'tis well-secured by the Savior's hand.
Though the tempest rage and the wild winds blow,
not an angry wave shall our boat o'erflow.

content.chorus:
We have an anchor that keeps the soul
steadfast and sure while the billows roll;
fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
grounded firm and deep in the Savior’s love.

verses.verse_content:
We saw Thee not when lifted high
Amid that wild and savage crew;
Nor heard we that imploring cry,
"Forgive, they know not what they do!"

content.chorus:
But we believe Thy footsteps trod
Its streets and plains, Thou Son of God:
But we believe Thy footsteps trod
Its streets and plains, Thou Son of God.

hymns.title: We Shall See The King Some Day

verses.verse_content:
After pain and anguish, after toil and care,
We shall see the King some day;
Thro' the endless ages joy and blessing share,
We shall see the King some day. (Chorus)

After foes are conquered, after battles won,
We shall see the King some day;
After strife is over, after set of sun,
We shall see the King some day. (Chorus)

content.chorus:
We shall see the King some day,
We will shout and sing some day;
Gathered ’round the throne,
When He shall call His own,
We shall see the King some day.

verses.verse_content:
We thank Thee, Lord, for this fair earth,
The glittering sky, the silver sea;
For all their beauty, all their worth,
Their light and glory, come from Thee.

Thine are the flowers that clothe the ground,
The trees that wave their arms above,
The hills that gird our dwellings round,
As Thou dost gird thine own with love.

Yet teach us still how far more fair,
More glorious, Father, in Thy sight,
Is one pure deed, one holy prayer,
One heart that owns Thy Spirit’s might.

So while we gaze with thoughtful eye
On all the gifts Thy love has given,
Help us in Thee to live and die,
By Thee to rise from earth to heaven.

hymns.title: We Thank Thee O Father {We Plow The Fields}

verses.verse_content:
We plow the fields and scatter the good seed on the land,
But it is fed and watered by God’s almighty hand.
He sends the snow in winter, the warmth to swell the grain,
The breezes and the sunshine, and soft refreshing rain.

content.chorus:
All good gifts around us are sent from heav’n above;
Then thank the Lord, O thank the Lord for all His love.

verses.verse_content:
We walk by faith, and not by sight;
No gracious words we hear
From Him who spoke as none ne'er spoke,
But we believe him near.

We may not touch His hands and side,
Nor follow where He trod;
But in His promise we rejoice,
And cry, "My Lord and God!"

Help then, O Lord, our unbelief;
And may our faith abound,
To call on you when you are near,
And seek where you are found.

O land of rest, for thee I sigh!
When will the moment come
When I shall lay my armor by
And dwell in peace at home?

To Jesus Christ I fled for rest;
He bade me cease to roam,
And lean for comfort on His breast
Till He conducts me home.

content.chorus:
We'll work till Jesus comes,
We'll work till Jesus comes,
We'll work till Jesus comes,
And we'll be gathered home.

verses.verse_content:
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?
Oh, sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?

Were you there when they nailed him to the tree?
Were you there when they nailed him to the tree?
Oh, sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they nailed him to the tree?

Were you there when they laid him in the tomb?
Were you there when they laid him in the tomb?
Oh, sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they laid him in the tomb?

Were you there when God raised him from the tomb?
Were you there when God raised him from the tomb?
Oh, sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when God raised him from the tomb?

hymns.title: What A Friend We Have In Jesus

verses.verse_content:
What a friend we have in Jesus,
all our sins and griefs to bear!
What a privilege to carry
everything to God in prayer!
O what peace we often forfeit,
O what needless pain we bear,
all because we do not carry
everything to God in prayer!

Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged;
take it to the Lord in prayer!
Can we find a friend so faithful
who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness;
take it to the Lord in prayer!

Are we weak and heavy laden,
cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Savior, still our refuge--
take it to the Lord in prayer!
Do your friends despise, forsake you?
Take it to the Lord in prayer!
In his arms he'll take and shield you;
you will find a solace there.

Man of sorrows what a name
for the Son of God, who came
ruined sinners to reclaim:
Hallelujah, what a Savior!

Bearing shame and scoffing rude,
in my place condemned he stood,
sealed my pardon with his blood:
Hallelujah, what a Savior!

Guilty, helpless, lost were we;
blameless Lamb of God was he,
sacrificed to set us free:
Hallelujah, what a Savior!

When he comes, our glorious King,
all his ransomed home to bring,
then anew this song we'll sing:
Hallelujah, what a Savior!

What will you do with Jesus?
The question comes to you!
And you must give an answer,
For something you must do.

"What will you do with Jesus?"
It comes by night and day;
With pierced hands uplifted,
He waits--what will you say?

What will you do with Jesus?
He's knocking at the door!
Refuse Him, soul, no longer,
Lest He should plead no more.

content.chorus:
What shall it be? what shall it be?
What shall your answer be?
What will you do with Jesus?
Oh, what shall your answer be?

verses.verse_content:
Not all earth’s gold and silver
Can make a sinner whole;
What shall it profit thee, O man,
If thou should’st lose thy soul?

The heaping up of riches
To many seems life’s goal;
But in the eager rush for wealth,
Forgotten is the soul.

This solemn question answer:
Is worldly gain thy goal?
Can fleeting riches be compared
To an immortal soul?

content.chorus:
What shall it profit a man,
What shall it profit a man,
If He gain the whole world,
And lose his own soul?

verses.verse_content:
Where will you spend eternity?
This question comes to you and me!
Tell me, what shall your answer be?
Where will you spend eternity?
Eternity! eternity!
Where will you spend eternity?

Many are choosing Christ today,
Turning from all their sins away;
Heav’n, shall their happy portion be?
Where will you spend eternity?
Eternity! eternity!
Where will you spend eternity?

Leaving the strait and narrow way,
Going the downward road today,
Sad will their final ending be,--
Lost thro’ a long eternity!
Eternity! eternity!
Lost thro’ a long eternity!

hymns.title: When He Comes In Glory By And By

verses.verse_content:
O how sweet ’twill be to meet the Lord,
When He comes in glory, by and by;
What a song of praise will be outpoured,
When He comes in glory, by and by.

We will have our robes all white as snow,
When He comes in glory, by and by;
O be ready, with the Lord to go,
When He comes in glory, by and by.

content.chorus:
How sweet! How sweet!
When He comes in the sky!
What joy! what joy!
When He comes in glory, by and by.

hymns.title: When I Get To The End Of The Way

verses.verse_content:
The sands have been washed in the footprints
Of the Stranger on Galilee’s shore;
And the voice that subdued the rough billows
Will be heard in Judea no more,
But the path of that lone Galilean,
With joy I will follow today,

Refrain
And the toils of the road will seem nothing
When I get to the end of the way,
The toils of the road will seem nothing
When I get to the end of the way.

When the last feeble steps have been taken,
And the gates of that city appear,
And the beautiful songs of the angels
Float out on my listening ear;
When all that now seems so mysterious,
Will be bright and as clear as the day,

Christ our Redeemer died on the cross,
Died for the sinner, paid all his due;
Sprinkle your soul with the blood of the Lamb,
And I will pass, will pass over you.

Judgment is coming, all will be there,
Each one receiving justly his due;
Hide in the saving, sin-cleansing blood,
And I will pass, will pass over you.

content.chorus:
When I see the blood,
When I see the blood,
When I see the blood,
I will pass, I will pass over you.

hymns.title: When I Survey The Wondrous Cross

verses.verse_content:
When I survey the wondrous cross
on which the Prince of glory died,
my richest gain I count but loss,
and pour contempt on all my pride.

Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast
save in the death of Christ, my God!
All the vain things that charm me most,
I sacrifice them through his blood.

See, from his head, his hands, his feet,
sorrow and love flow mingled down.
Did e'er such love and sorrow meet,
or thorns compose so rich a crown?

Were the whole realm of nature mine,
that were a present far too small.
Love so amazing, so divine,
demands my soul, my life, my all.

O Jesus, Saviour of the lost,
My Rock and Hiding place,
By storms of sin and sorrow toss'd,
I seek Thy sheltering grace.

And when I stand before Thy throne,
And all Thy glory see,
Still be my righteousness alone
To hide myself in Thee.

hymns.title: When My Love To Christ Grows Weak

verses.verse_content:
When my love to Christ grows weak,
When for deeper faith I seek,
Then in thought I go to thee,
Garden of Gethsemane.

When my love for man grows weak,
When for stronger faith I seek,
Hill of Calvary, I go
To the scenes of fear and woe.

There behold His agony,
Suffered on the bitter tree;
See His anguish, see His faith,
Love triumphant still in death.

hymns.title: When The Roll Is Called Up Yonder

verses.verse_content:
When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound and time shall be no more,
And the morning breaks, eternal, bright and fair;
When the saved of earth shall gather over on the other shore,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

On that bright and cloudless morning when the dead in Christ shall rise,
And the glory of his resurrection share;
When his chosen ones shall gather to their home beyond the skies,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

Let us labor for the Master from the dawn till setting sun;
Let us talk of all his wondrous love and care.
Then when all of life is over and our work on earth is done,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

Cuando la trompeta suene en aquel día final,
y el alba eterna rompa en claridad; cuando las naciones salvas
a su patria lleguen ya, y allá se pase lista, yo he de estar.

Estribillo:
Cuando allá se pase lista,
cuando allá se pase lista,
cuando allá se pase lista,
a mi nombre yo feliz responderé.

En aquel dia sin nieblas en que muerte ya no habrá,
y su gloria el Salvador impartirá; cuando los llamados entren
a su celestial hogar, y allá se pase lista, yo he de estar. [Estribillo]

content.chorus:
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

hymns.title: When We All Get To Heaven

verses.verse_content:
Sing the wondrous love of Jesus,
Sing His mercy and His grace;
In the mansions bright and blessed
He'll prepare for us a place.

While we walk the pilgrim pathway
Clouds will overspread the sky;
But when trav'ling days are over
Not a shadow, not a sigh.

Let us then be true and faithful,
Trusting, serving ev'ry day;
Just one glimpse of Him in glory
Will the toils of life repay.

content.chorus:
When we all get to heaven,
what a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we all see Jesus,
we'll sing and shout the victory!

Where He leads I’ll follow,
Follow all the way.
Where He leads I’ll follow,
Follow Jesus ev’ry day.

hymns.title: Where He Leads Me I Will Follow

verses.verse_content:
I can hear my Savior calling,
I can hear my Savior calling,
I can hear my Savior calling,
"Take thy cross and follow, follow Me."

I'll go with Him through the garden,
I'll go with Him through the garden,
I'll go with Him through the garden,
I'll go with Him, with Him all the way.

I'll go with Him through the judgment,
I'll go with Him through the judgment,
I'll go with Him through the judgment,
I'll go with Him, with Him all the way.

He will give me grace and glory,
He will give me grace and glory,
He will give me grace and glory,
and go with me, with me all the way.

hymns.title: Where Love Is In The Home

verses.verse_content:
Happy the home when God is there,
and love fills ev'ry breast;
when one their wish, and one their prayer,
and one their heav’nly rest.

Happy the home where Jesus’ name
is sweet to ev'ry ear,
where children early speak His fame,
and parents hold Him dear.

Happy the home where prayer is heard,
and praise is quick to rise,
where parents love the sacred Word,
and all its wisdom prize.

hymns.title: Where The Gates Swing Outward Never

verses.verse_content:
Just a few more days to be filled with praise,
And to tell the old, old story;
Then, when twilight falls, and my Savior calls,
I shall go to Him in glory.

Just a few more years with their toil and tears,
And the journey will be ended;
Then I’ll be with Him, where the tide of time
With eternity is blended.

Tho' the hills be steep and the valleys deep,
With no flow'rs my way adorning;
Tho' the night be lone and my rest a stone,
Joy awaits me in the morning.

content.chorus:
I’ll exchange my cross for a starry crown,
Where the gates swing outward never;
At His feet I’ll lay ev'ry burden down,
And with Jesus reign forever.

hymns.title: Where We'll Never Grow Old {I Have Heard Of A Land (Moore)}

verses.verse_content:
I have heard of a land
On the faraway strand,
’Tis a beautiful home of the soul;
Built by Jesus on high,
There we never shall die,
’Tis a land where we never grow old.

In that beautiful home
Where we’ll nevermore roam,
We shall be in the sweet by and by;
Happy praise to the King
Through eternity sing,
’Tis a land where we never shall die.

content.chorus:
Never grow old,
Where we'll never grow old,
In a land where we’ll never grow old;
Never grow old,
Where we'll never grow old,
In a land where we’ll never grow old.

verses.verse_content:
Where will you spend eternity?
This question comes to you and me!
Tell me, what shall your answer be?
Where will you spend eternity?
Eternity! eternity!
Where will you spend eternity?

Many are choosing Christ today,
Turning from all their sins away;
Heav’n, shall their happy portion be?
Where will you spend eternity?
Eternity! eternity!
Where will you spend eternity?

Leaving the strait and narrow way,
Going the downward road today,
Sad will their final ending be,--
Lost thro’ a long eternity!
Eternity! eternity!
Lost thro’ a long eternity!

hymns.title: While Jesus Whispers To You {Come, Sinner, Come}

verses.verse_content:
While Jesus whispers to you,
Come, sinner, come!
While we are praying for you,
Come, sinner, come!
Now is the time to own Him,
Come, sinner, come!
Now is the time to know Him,
Come, sinner, come!

Are you too heavy laden!
Come, sinner, come!
Jesus will bear your burden,
Come, sinner, come!
Jesus will not deceive you,
Come, sinner, come!
Jesus can now redeem you,
Come, sinner, come!

hymns.title: While We Pray And While We Plead {Why Not Now}

verses.verse_content:
While we pray and while we plead,
While you see your soul’s deep need,
While our Father calls you home,
Will you not, my brother, come?

In the world you’ve failed to find
Aught of peace for troubled mind;
Come to Christ, on Him believe,
Peace and joy you shall receive.

content.chorus:
Why not now? Why not now?
Why not come to Jesus now?
Why not now? Why not now?
Why not come to Jesus now?

verses.verse_content:
Soft as the voice of an angel,
Breathing a lesson unheard,
Hope with a gentle persuasion,
Whispers her comforting word.
Wait till the darkness is over,
Wait till the tempest is done,
Hope for the sunshine tomorrow,
After the shower is gone.

If in the dusk of the twilight,
Dim be the region afar,
Will not the deepening darkness
Brighten the glimmering star?
Then when the night is upon us,
Why should the heart sink away?
When the dark midnight is over,
Watch for the breaking of day.

content.chorus:
Whispering Hope
O how welcome thy voice,
Making my heart in its sorrow rejoice.

verses.verse_content:
Lord Jesus, look down from Thy throne in the skies,
And help me to make a complete sacrifice;
I give up myself, and whatever I know,
Now wash me and I shall be whiter than snow.

Lord Jesus, for this I most humbly entreat,
I wait, blessed Lord, at Thy crucified feet;
By faith, for my cleansing I see Thy blood flow,
Now wash me and I shall be whiter than snow.

content.chorus:
Whiter than snow, yes, whiter than snow,
Now wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

hymns.title: Who At The Door Is Standing {Who At My Door Is Standing}

verses.verse_content:
Who at my door is standing,
Patiently drawing near,
Entrance within demanding?
Whose is the voice I hear?

Lonely without He’s staying:
Lonely within am I;
While I am still delaying,
Will He not pass me by?

All through the dark hours dreary,
Knocking again is He;
Jesus, art Thou not weary,
Waiting so long for me?

Door of my heart, I hasten!
Thee will I open wide.
Though He rebuke and chasten,
He shall with me abide.

content.chorus:
Sweetly the tones are falling;
“Open the door for me!
If thou wilt heed My calling,
I will abide with thee.”

verses.verse_content:
Who will follow Jesus,
Standing for the right,
Holding up his banner
In the thickest fight?
List'ning for his orders,
Ready to obey,
Who will follow Jesus,
Serving him to-day?

Who will follow Jesus
In life's busy ways,
Working for the Master,
Giving him the praise?
Eearnest in his vineyard,
Honoring his laws,
Faithful to his counsel,
Watchful for his cause?

Who will follow Jesus?
When the tempter charms,
Fleeing then, for safety
To the Saviour's arms;
Trusting in his mercy,
Trusting in his power,
Seeking fresh renewals
Of his grace each hour.

content.chorus:
Who will follow Jesus?
Who will make reply,
"I am on the Lord's side,
Master, here am I?"
Who will follow Jesus?
Who will make reply,
"I am on the Lord's side,
Master, here am I?"

verses.verse_content:
“Whosoever heareth,” shout, shout the sound!
Spread the blessed tidings all the world around.
Tell the joyful news wherever man is found:
“Whosoever will may come.”

Whosoever cometh need not delay.
Now the door is open; enter while you may;
Jesus is the true, the only Living Way.
“Whosoever will may come.”

hymns.title: Why Did My Savior Come To Earth {He Loved Me So}

verses.verse_content:
Why did my Savior come to earth,
And to the humble go?
Why did He choose a lowly birth?
Because He loved me so!

Why did He drink the bitter cup
Of sorrow, pain and woe?
Why on the cross be lifted up?
Because He loved me so!

content.chorus:
He loved me so,
He loved me so;
He gave His precious life for me, for me,
Because, He loved me so.

hymns.title: Why Do I Sing About Jesus

verses.verse_content:
Deep in my heart there's a gladness;
Jesus has saved me from sin!
Praise to His name, what a Savior!
Cleansing without and within!

content.chorus:
Why do I sing about Jesus?
Why is He precious to me?
He is my Lord and my Savior;
dying, He set me free!

verses.verse_content:
Why do you wait, dear brother,
O why do you tarry so long?
Your Savior is waiting to give you
A place in His sanctified throng.

Refrain
Why not, why not,
Why not come to Him now?
Why not, why not,
Why not come to Him now?

What do you hope, dear brother,
To gain by a further delay?
There’s no one to save you but Jesus,
There’s no other way but His way.

Do you not feel, dear brother,
His Spirit now striving within?
O why not accept His salvation
And throw off your burden of sin?

Why keep Jesus waiting,
Waiting in the cold?
He will bear you gently,
Gently to His fold;
See Him, soul, and open,
Open, I implore.

Why keep Jesus waiting,
Waiting at the door?
Oft He knocketh softly,
Softly o’er and o’er;
Hear Him, soul, and open,
Open, I implore.

Why keep Jesus pleading,
Pleading at the door?
He would be your Saviour,
Ever, evermore;
Love Him, soul, and open,
Open, I implore.

Why keep Jesus waiting--
Knocking at the door?
Soon He’ll cease His pleading,
Yes, for evermore;
Come, poor soul, obey Him,
Open, I implore.

When Jesus comes to reward His servants,
Whether it be noon or night,
Faithful to Him will He find us watching,
With our lamps all trimmed and bright?

If, at the dawn of the early morning,
He shall call us one by one,
When to the Lord we restore our talents,
Will He answer you, "Well done?"

Have we been true to the trust He left us?
Do we seek to do our best?
If in our hearts there is naught condemns us,
We shall have a glorious rest.

content.chorus:
O can we say we are ready, brother?
Ready for the soul’s bright home?
Say, will He find you and me still watching,
Waiting, watching when the Lord shall come?

verses.verse_content:
Softly and tenderly Jesus is calling,
calling for you and for me;
see, on the portals he's waiting and watching,
watching for you and for me.

Why should we tarry when Jesus is pleading,
pleading for you and for me?
Why should we linger and heed not his mercies,
mercies for you and for me?

Time is now fleeting, the moments are passing,
passing from you and from me;
shadows are gathering, deathbeds are coming,
coming for you and for me.

O for the wonderful love he has promised,
promised for you and for me!
Though we have sinned, he has mercy and pardon,
pardon for you and for me.

hymns.title: Will You Not Tell It Today

verses.verse_content:
If the name of the Savior is precious to you,
If His care has been constant and tender and true,
If the light of His presence has brightened your way,
O will you not tell of your gladness today?

If your faith in the Savior has brought its reward,
If a strength you have found in the strength of your Lord,
If the hope of a rest in His palace is sweet,
O will you not, brother, the story repeat?

content.chorus:
Oh, will you not tell it today?
Will you not tell it today?
If the light of His presence has brightened your way,
Oh, will you not tell it today?

verses.verse_content:
Come, and let us sweetly join,
Christ to praise in hymns divine;
give we all with one accord
glory to our common Lord.

Hands and hearts and voices raise,
sing as in the ancient days;
antedate the joys above,
celebrate the feast of love.

Sanctify us, Lord, and bless,
breathe thy Spirit, give thy peace;
thou thyself within us move,
make our feast a feast of love.

In vain in high and holy lays
My soul her grateful voice would raise;
For who can sing the worthy praise
Of the wonderful love of Jesus!

A joy by day, a peace by night,
In storms a calm, in darkness light;
In pain a balm, in weakness might
Is the wonderful love of Jesus.

content.chorus:
Wonderful love! wonderful love!
Wonderful love of Jesus!
Wonderful love! wonderful love!
Wonderful love of Jesus!

verses.verse_content:
O God of love, O King of peace,
Make wars throughout the world to cease;
Our greed and violent ways restrain.
Give peace, O God, give peace again.

Remember, Lord, your works of old,
The wonders that your people told;
Remember not our sins' deep stain.
Give peace, O God, give peace again.

Whom shall we trust but you, O Lord?
Where rest but on your faithful word?
None ever called on you in vain.
Give peace, O God, give peace again.

There's a wonderful place we call home,
'Tis a city of glory divine,
It is built in the garden of rest,
And that beautiful home shall be mine,
O that wonderful Eden, so blest,
Where Jesus, the Master has gone
To prepare us this glorious home.
There He bids us a welcome to come.

O how sweet it will be there to dwell
With the Saviour and Father of all,
In a palace of diamond and gold,
Where no evil to us can befall;
There no sorrow that home shall invade,
And our loved ones no more there shall die;
One celestial, unbroken, sweet day,
While eternities' ages roll by.

content.chorus:
O wonderful city of God,
Just across in that beautiful clime,
Where the angels' sweet echo of song
In musical cadencies chime
O wonderful city of God,
By faith in the distance I see,
There's a mansion prepared over there,
Yes, a place in that city for me.

verses.verse_content:
Wonderful grace of Jesus,
greater than all my sin;
how shall my tongue describe it,
where shall its praise begin?
Taking away my burden,
setting my spirit free,
for the wonderful grace of Jesus reaches me.

Wonderful grace of Jesus,
reaching to all the lost,
by it I have been pardoned,
saved to the uttermost.
Chains have been torn asunder,
giving me liberty,
for the wonderful grace of Jesus reaches me.

content.chorus:
Wonderful the matchless grace of Jesus,
deeper than the mighty rolling sea,
higher than the mountain, sparkling like a fountain,
all sufficient grace for even me;
broader than the scope of my transgressions, sing it!
greater far than all my sin and shame.
O magnify the precious name of Jesus, praise his name!

verses.verse_content:
There is never a day so dreary,
there is never a night so long,
but the soul that is trusting Jesus
will somewhere find a song.

There is never a cross so heavy,
there is never a weight of woe,
but that Jesus will help to carry
because He loveth so.

There is never a care or burden,
there is never a grief or loss,
but that Jesus in love will lighten
when carried to the cross.

content.chorus:
Wonderful, wonderful Jesus,
in the heart He implanteth a song:
a song of deliverance, of courage, of strength;
in the heart He implanteth a song.

verses.verse_content:
Coming to Jesus, my Savior, I found
Wonderful peace, wonderful peace;
Storms in their fury may rage all around,
I have peace, sweet peace.

Peace like a river, so deep and so broad,
Wonderful peace, wonderful peace;
Resting my soul on the bosom of God,
I have peace, sweet peace.

Peace like a holy and infinite calm,
Wonderful peace, wonderful peace;
Like to the strains of an evening psalm,
I have peace, sweet peace.

content.chorus:
Peace,peace, wonderful peace,
Peace, peace, glorious peace;
Since my Redeemer has ransomed my soul,
I have peace, sweet peace.

verses.verse_content:
Wonderful story of love!
Tell it to me again;
Wonderful story of love!
Wake the immortal strain.
Angels with rapture announce it,
Shepherds with wonder receive it;
Sinner, O won’t you believe it?
Wonderful story of love!

Wonderful story of love!
Though you are far away;
Wonderful story of love!
Still he doth call today.
Calling from Calvary’s mountain,
Down from the crystal bright fountain,
E’en from the dawn of creation;
Wonderful story of love!

content.chorus:
Wonderful! Wonderful!
Wonderful story, Wonderful story of love!

verses.verse_content:
There is never a day so dreary,
there is never a night so long,
but the soul that is trusting Jesus
will somewhere find a song.

There is never a cross so heavy,
there is never a weight of woe,
but that Jesus will help to carry
because He loveth so.

There is never a care or burden,
there is never a grief or loss,
but that Jesus in love will lighten
when carried to the cross.

content.chorus:
Wonderful, wonderful Jesus,
in the heart He implanteth a song:
a song of deliverance, of courage, of strength;
in the heart He implanteth a song.

verses.verse_content:
Swetly echo the gospel call,
Wonderful words of life
Offer pardon and peace to all, wonderful words of life
Jesus, only Savior, sanctify forever.

content.chorus:
Beautiful words, wonderful words,
wonderful words of life.
Beautiful words, wonderful words,
wonderful words of life.

verses.verse_content:
Now thank we all our God
with heart and hands and voices,
who wondrous things has done,
in whom his world rejoices;
who from our mothers' arms
has blessed us on our way
with countless gifts of love,
and still is ours today.

O may this bounteous God
through all our life be near us,
with ever joyful hearts
and blessed peace to cheer us,
to keep us in his grace,
and guide us when perplexed,
and free us from all ills
of this world in the next.

All praise and thanks to God
the Father now be given,
the Son and Spirit blest,
who reign in highest heaven
the one eternal God,
whom heaven and earth adore;
for thus it was, is now,
and shall be evermore.

hymns.title: Work For The Night Is Coming

verses.verse_content:
Work, for the night is coming:
Work through the sunny noon;
Fill brightest hours with labor:
Rest comes sure and soon.
Give every flying minute
Something to keep in store;
Work, for the night is coming,
When man works no more.

Wounded for me, wounded for me,
Wounded for me, He was wounded for me.
Gone my transgressions and now I am free,
All because Jesus was wounded for me.

Dying for me, dying for me,
Dying for me, He was dying for me.
Gone my transgressions and now I am free,
All because Jesus was dying for me.

Risen for me, risen for me,
Risen for me, He is risen for me.
Gone my transgressions and now I am free,
All because Jesus is risen for me.

hymns.title: Ye Are The Light Of The World

verses.verse_content:
Ye are the light of the world,
Driving the darkness away,
Shedding your beams on the lost,
Changing their night into day.
Then let your light ever shine,
Showing the right way to go;
Gladly the lost ones will see—
God’s boundless love they will know.

Ye are the light of the world,
Causing the clouds to depart,
Throwing the sunshine of peace
Down on the poor burdened heart.
Then let your light ever shine;
Loved ones are panting for rest;
Sunshine their souls will revive,
Lifting them up to the blest.

A ruler once harkened to Jesus by night
To ask him the way of salvation and light;
The master made answer in words true and plain:
You must be born again.

O children of frailty, attend to the word
So solemnly uttered by Jesus, the Lord,
And let not this message to you be in vain:
You must be born again.

O ye who would enter that glorious rest,
And sing with the ransomed the song of the blest,
The life everlasting if you would obtain,
You must be born again.

content.chorus:
You must be born again,
You must be born again,
I verily, verily say unto you,
You must be born again.

hymns.title: Years I Spent In Vanity {At Calvary}

verses.verse_content:
Years I spent in vanity and pride,
Caring not my Lord was crucified,
Knowing not it was for me He died on Calvary.

By God's Word at last my sin I learned–
Then I trembled at the Law I'd spurned,
Till my guilty soul imploring turned to Calvary.

Now I've giv'n to Jesus ev'rything,
Now I gladly own Him as my King,
Now my raptured soul can only sing of Calvary.

content.chorus:
Mercy there was great and grace was free,
Pardon there was multiplied to me,
There my burdened soul found liberty–
At Calvary.

hymns.title: Yes For Me For Me He Careth (Woodring-Sanderson)

verses.verse_content:
Yes, for me, for me he careth
With a brother's tender care;
Yes, with me, with me he shareth
Ev'ry burden, ev'ry fear.
Yes, o'er me, o'er me he watcheth,
Ceaseless watcheth, night and day;
Yes, e'en me, e'en me he snatcheth
From the perils of the way.

Yes, for me, he standeth pleading
At the mercy seat above;
Ever for me interceding,
Constant in untiring love.
Yes, in me, in me he dwelleth;
I in him, and he in me!
And my empty soul he filleth,
Here and through eternity.

Yield not to temptation,
for yielding is sin.
Each vict'ry will help you
some other to win.
Fight valiantly onward;
dark passions subdue.
Look ever to Jesus;
He'll carry you through.

Shun evil companions;
bad language disdain.
God’s name hold in rev'rence,
nor take it in vain.
Be thoughtful and earnest,
kind-hearted and true.
Look ever to Jesus;
He'll carry you through.

content.chorus:
Ask the Savior to help you,
comfort, strengthen, and keep you.
He is willing to aid you;
He will carry you through.

hymns.title: You Never Mentioned Him To Me

verses.verse_content:
When in the better land before the bar we stand,
How deeply grieved our souls may be;
If any lost one there should cry in deep despair,
"You never mentioned Him to me."

Oh, let us spread the word where'er it may be heard,
Help groping souls the light to see,
That yonder none may say, "you showed me not the way,"
"You never mentioned Him to me."

content.chorus:
"You never mentioned Him to me,
You helped me not the light to see;
You met me day by day and knew I was astray,
Yet never mentioned Him to me."

hymns.title: We're Marching To Zion {Come We That Love The Lord)

verses.verse_content:
Come, we that love the Lord,
and let our joys be known;
join in a song with sweet accord,
and thus surround the throne.

Let those refuse to sing
who never knew our God;
but children of the heav'nly King
may speak their joys abroad.

The hill of Zion yields
a thousand sacred sweets
before we reach the heav'nly fields,
or walk the golden streets.

content.chorus:
We’re marching to Zion,
(We’re marching on to Zion,) 
Beautiful, beautiful Zion;
We’re marching upward
to Zion, (Zion, Zion,)
The beautiful city of God.

verses.verse_content:
Alas! and did my Savior bleed,
and did my Sovereign die!
Would he devote that sacred head
for sinners such as I?

Was it for crimes that I have done,
he groaned upon the tree?
Amazing pity! Grace unknown!
And love beyond degree!

Well might the sun in darkness hide,
and shut its glories in,
when God, the mighty maker, died
for his own creature's sin.

Thus might I hide my blushing face
while his dear cross appears;
dissolve my heart in thankfulness,
and melt mine eyes to tears.

But drops of tears can ne'er repay
the debt of love I owe.
Here, Lord, I give myself away;
'tis all that I can do.

content.chorus:
At the cross, at the cross,
where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away,
(rolled away,)
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day.

verses.verse_content:
I hear Your welcome voice
that calls me by Your will,
for cleansing in Your precious blood
that flowed on Calvary's hill.

’Tis Jesus calls me on
to perfect faith and love,
to perfect hope, and peace, and trust,
for earth and heaven above.

’Tis Jesus who confirms
the blessèd work within,
by adding grace to welcomed grace,
where reigned the power of sin.

content.chorus:
I am coming, Lord,
coming by Your will:
wash me, cleanse me, by the blood
that flowed on Calvary's hill.

verses.verse_content:
Asafo no fapem koro 
Ne yɛn Wura Yesu 
Ɔnam nsuo ne N’ asɛm so 
Yɛɛ N’abɔdeɔ foforɔ 
Ofi soro bɛhwehwɛɛ no 
Yɛɛ N’ ayeforɔ kronkron 
Ɔde ne mogya tɔɔ no 
Ne nkwa nti na owui.

Wɔpaa no fi amanaman mu 
Nanso ɔyɛ asafo koro 
Ne nkwagyeɛ tumi no ni 
Wura koro, Gyidie koro 
Ohyira din kronkron biako 
Di n’ aduan kronkron no 
Anidasoɔ koro na ɔpɔro 
Adom nyinaa wɔ mu.

Sɛ nnipa si m’ atweetwe 
Hwɛ n’ ahokyerɛ kɛseɛ 
Mpaapaamu a atete mu 
Ne Nkyerɛkyerɛ bɔne a 
Ahotefoɔ no wɛn su 
Sɛ: Ɛnkosi da bɛn? 
Anadwo su ne renkyɛ
Na adan anɔpa dwom.

Hwan na ‘bɛdi Yesu akyi? 
Agyina ama tenenee 
Ama ne frankaa no so 
Wɔ ‘ko kɛse mu 
Atie ne mara no pɛsɛ ɔbɛdi so 
Hwan na bɛdi 
Yesu akyi asom no ɛnnɛ?

Hwan na ɔbɛdi Yesu akyi abrabɔ yi mu 
Yɛ adwuma ma owura no ayi no ayɛ 
Abɔ mɔden n’afuom adi ne mara so 
Atie n’afotuo ahwɛ ne ho ‘yie.

Hwan n’ɔbɛdi Yesu akyi sɛ nsɔhwɛ ba a 
Adwan’ akɔ asomdwoe Agyenkwa no nsam 
Atwere n’ahumɔbɔ atwere ne tumi 
Ahwehwɛ ayɛ foforo n’adom mu merɛ nyinaa?

Hwan na n’ɔbɛdi Yesu akyi ne ‘dɔ adwuma yi mu 
Twetwe nkorɔfoɔ ma no wɔ mpaebɔ mu 
Asomfoɔ nokwafoɔ yɛ hu na sɛm mu 
Saa Agynkwa yi bɛ wɔ yɛafa daadaa.

content.chorus:
Hwan na ɔbɛdi Yesu akyi Hwan na ɔbua sɛ 
‘Mewɔ Awurade afa me wura me wɔ ha’ 
Hwan na ‘bɛdi Yesu akyi Hwan na ɔbua sɛ 
Mewɔ Awurade afa me wura me wɔ ha’.

verses.verse_content:
Magyaa adeɛ nyinaa ama Yesu 
Mede ne nyinaa a,a N’kwa 
Medɔ No na mɛtwere No 
Mɛtena N’anim daa nyinaa

Magyaa ne nyinaa ama Yesu 
Mekoto ne nana se 
Wiase mu anigyeɛ m’apaw 
Yesu fam seisei ara

Magyaa ne nyinaa ama Yesu 
Agyenkwa fa m’yɛ wo deɛ ara

Nkwagye kɛseɛ mu anigyeɛ

content.chorus:
Magyaa ne nyinaa ara m’ 
Magyaa ne nyinaa ara m’ 
Mede ma Wo hyirafo Yesu 
Magyaa nyinaa ara m’

verses.verse_content:
Monyinaa monkamfo Yesu din 
Abɔfoɔ mutu fam 
Momfa ahenkyɛ mɛhyɛ no 
Na monsi no ɔhempɔn.

Mo Israel mma a wɔapa mo 
Ayi mo asehweɛ mu 
Monkamfo nea ɔgye mo nkwa 
Na monsi no hempɔn

Moma abusua ne kana nyinaa, 
Wɔ asase yi so 
Mfa tumi nyinaa mma no 
Na monyi hempɔn ayɛ.

Ao, anka yɛn ne sorofoɔ 
Atwa ahwe ne nan ase

M’akoma mu,m’akoma mu, 
Bra m’akoma,
Owura Yesu 
Bra mu ɛnnɛ,
bra bɛtra mu 
Bra m’akoma mu,
Owura Yesu

Tie, wo Yesu nne dɛɛdɛ no refrɛ 
Ɛgyegye brɛoo woaso mu 
Ɔrefrɛ ɔdɔ ne ahumɔbrɔ mu

Fa Ne kɔndua no efisɛ ɔdwo 
Soa w’adesoa kɔ ne nkyɛn

Ɔbɛ kyerɛ sɛ wo sua a.

Yɛ asotie ma Ne dɔ nne brɛoo no

content.chorus:
Mo a moabrɛ na mo nnesoa mu ayɛdu 
Monywerɛ mo wura no bom 
Mo a moabrɛ na mo nnesoa mu ayɛdu 
Monmra mɛgye mo ahome.

hymns.title: SE AHOTEFO SEN KO MU A

verses.verse_content:
Meyɛ ɔkwantuni brɛfoɔ 
Nenam bɔne wiase yi mu 
Reseisei me ho ama kuro no 
Sɛ ahotefoɔ sen kɔ mu a

Sɛ mɛhu Agyenkwa no a 
Sɛ sɛ me bu bra foforɔ 
Ansa na ma ka anigye kuo n’ ho 
Sɛ ahotefoɔ sen kɔ mu a.

Medi me Gyefo no akyi 
Nnamɔn a woagya no mu 
Saa na mɛhu sɛ ɔbɛfrɛ me 
Sɛ ahotefoɔ sen kɔ mu a

Ɔsoro hɔ mɛhu m’ Agyenkwa a 
Ɔgye me kra fi bɔne m’ 
Na ɔbɛyɛ me atuu 
Sɛ ahotefoɔ sen kɔ mu a.

content.chorus:
Sɛ ahotefoɔ sen kɔ mu a 
Sɛ ahotefoɔ sen kɔ mu a 
‘Wura mepɛ sɛ meka ho bi 
Sɛ ahotefoɔ sen kɔ mu a

verses.verse_content:

verses.verse_content:
Adɛn na m’ Agyenkwa baa asase so

Fisɛ Ɔdɔ me saa.

Adɛn na Ɔnom amane ne yea 
Kuruwa nwononwono ano? 
Adɛn na Ɔsɛnee asɛnnua no ho? 
Fisɛ Ɔdɔ me saa.

Mɛto N’ ayeyie dwom na waba 
Na makɔ N’anuonyam mu

content.chorus:

verses.verse_content:
Menim sɛ me gyefoɔ te ase

Menim daa nkwa a ɔde mae

Ɔpɛ sɛ me yɛ kronkron 
Kasam’ adwenem’ , neyɔem’ 
Na ma hu n’anim kronkron no 
Bere a mɛfi asaase yi so.

Menim sɛ ne gyeɛ adom no 
Wɔ hɔ ma abɔnefoɔ 
Menim sɛ ɔbɛba bio abɛfa 
M’akɔ fie wɔ soro hɔ.

Menim sɛ wasiesie baabi 
Wɔ nohoaa ama me 
Efie, a w’anfa nsa ansi 
Na ɛyɛ fɛ kyɛn so.

content.chorus:

Menim, menim daa nkwa a ɔde ma 
Menim, menim sɛ megyefoɔ te ase.

verses.verse_content:

verses.verse_content:
Nkateɛ dɛdɛ ba m’ akomam 
Ɛyɛ ahosɛpɛ dwom bi

‘Somdwoe Nyame dɔ akyɛdeɛ

Kristo gyee asomdwoe asendua so

Berɛ a me faa Yesu sɛ me wura

Mete Yesu mu pɛ asomdwoe

content.chorus:
‘Somdwoe dɛɛdɛ 
‘Somdwoe nwanwa a ɛfi soro

verses.verse_content:
Agyenkwa wo dɔ nti 
Wowu maa me 
Ɛmmfata sɛ mede 
Biribi kam’ wo 
Dɔm’ me kra koto wo 
Adi ne bɔhyɛ so 
Na wabɔ afɔdeɛ 
Ama w’seesei.

Ma me nokorɛ koma 
A ɛsɛ wo de no 
Na dabiara mu no 
Woahu me sɛ 
Mahyɛ dɔ dwuma bi ase 
Mayɛ ayamyɛ bi 
Matwe kobɔfoɔ bi 
Mede ama wo.

Deɛ mewɔ, deɛ meteɛ 
W’akyɛdeɛ kwa 
Dɛ mu o yea mu o 
‘Wura meyɛ wo de 
Na mehu woanim a 
Me kra a woagye nyinaa no yi 
Merɛsanten nyinaa mu 
Bɛyɛ wode.

Kristofoɔ asraafoɔ 
Monnuom akono Yesu asennua no 
De yɛn anim kan Yɛn Hene atu sa 
Reko tia tamfoɔ Monnuom sraban no so
Monhwɛ Ne frankaa.

Yɛma Ne frankaa so a 
Ɔbonsam dɔm gu Ɛnneɛ Kristo akofoɔ 
Monkɔdi nkonim Yɛbɔ se yi ayɛ a 
Saman fapem him 
Anuanom monto nnwom 
Momma mo nne so.

Ahennwa bɛtutu 
Ahennie atwam Yesu asɔre de 
Ɛbɛtim hɔ daa Asaman apon no 
Rentumi nhyɛ so Yɛwɔ Kristo bɔhyɛ 
N’ asɛm rentwam da.

Me nkurɔfoɔ momɛdɔm 
Anigyeɛ kuo yi 
Mommra na yɛmmom nto 
Yɛn nkunim dwom yi 
Anuonyam ne nkamfoɔ 
Nka yɛ Hene no 
Nnipa ne abɔfoɔ 
Bɛto dwom yi daa.

content.chorus:
Kristofoɔ asraaafoɔ 
Monnuom akono 
Yesu asennua no 
Di yɛn anim kan.

verses.verse_content:
Memfɛre m’Awurade ho 
Sɛ mɛko ama no 
Mɛsɔ N’asɛm no nidie mu

Yesu, me Nyame menim No

Ͻremma me kra mfere da

Ͻbɛntumi asie

Ͻbɛbɔ wɔ N’Agya anim hɔ

Wama me kra tenabea

hymns.title: Oyi Ne Nyame A Yesom No

verses.verse_content:
Oyi ne Nyame a yεsom No

Ɛka bɛn na me deɛ me wura

Memfa m’ade bi nkame wo

Menni sika anaa dwetɛ 
Nanso mennfa biribi nkwan’ wo 
Menkwa, medɔ ne me som nso

Wotuaa me ka asɛnnua so

verses.verse_content:
Yɛrenante Agyenkwa anamɔn mu. 
Yɛredi yɛn Agyenkwa ne hene akyi 
Yɛde ne nsɛnnahɔ no bu yɛn bra 
‘Nigye, anigye nwom na yɛde ba.

Yɛtwe pini deɛ ɔdii yɛanim no ho 
Sɛ sɔhwɛ ma yɛfi kwan no mu a, 
Yɛdan basa denden ɛbɔ yɛn ho ban 
‘Nigye mu na yɛyi n’ayɛ daa.

Yɛrenante Agyenkwa anamɔn mu 
Yɛdi yɛ kwankyerɛfoɔ n’akyi kɔ soro 
Sɛ yɛhu yɛn hene wɔ n’ahoɔfɛm 
‘Nigye mu na yɛbɛtena ne nkyɛn.

content.chorus:

Ɛyɛ fɛ sɛ yɛ nante Agyenkwa anamɔn mu

verses.verse_content:
Wo ne me ntena ade reyɛ asa 
Sum reduru, awurade tena menkyɛn 
Aboafoɔ pa, ne awerɛkyekyefoɔ sa a 
O Ankonam Boafoɔ, Wo ne me ntena.

Yɛn nkwa nna ketewa yi retwam kɔ 
Wiase dɛ repa, n’ anuonyam resen 
Ɔsɛe ne nsakyera nko na me hu ha Ao, 
Wo a Wonsakyera da, Wo ne me ntena.

Mehia Wo wɔ me nkyɛn berɛ nyinaa 
W’adom na ɛka sɔhwɛfoɔ no hyɛ 
Gyefoɔ, kyuingyinafoɔ bɛn ɛne wo sɛ? 
Sum mu o, hann mu o, Wo ne me ntena.

Sɛ me ne Wo nam a mensuro hwee 
Ɔyea nyɛ duru, nnisuo nyɛ nnwono 
Wuo bɔre, damoa nkonim ɛwɔ he? 
Medi nkonim daa sɛ Wo ne me tena a.

Memua mani a yi W’asennua kyerɛ me. 
Hyerɛn sum mu, kyerɛ me soro kwan 
Ɔsoro hyerɛn, wiase kusuu resa 
Owuo mu o, nkwa mu o, Wo ne me ntena.

Yiw me na ɔde ɔdɔ 
Ne ahwɛyie dwen me ho 
Yiw ɔne me kyɛ 
Me nnesoa ne me hu nyinaa 
Yiw me so, me so na ɔhwɛ 
Ɔwɛn me awia ne anadwo 
Yiw me mpo, me mpo 
Ɔhwim me fi ɔkwan mu mmusuo mu.

Yiw ɔgyina ahummɔbɔ adwa anim 
Resrɛ ma me 
Na ɔkɔ so di ma me ɔdɔ a ɛnsa da mu 
Yiw ɔma me nya wɔ me mu
Soro anigye, ɔdɔ, ɛne hann 
Na ɔde ne dɔ taban tumi no 
Kata me so.

Yiw ɔte, ɔte me mu 
Na me nso me te ne mu 
Ɔde anidaso hyɛ me kra ma 
Maba mu bu a 
Ɛnti merewen ne mmae 
Mereto dwom akɔ soro 
Anɔpa ahosɛpɛ nnwom 
Ne anwumere nnwom.

Ka me ho ‘wura 
Mentumi nkwati wo ntena ase 
Mentumi nnya wo ntu ‘namɔn biako 
Wo ammoa me a 
Menntumi nsoa ‘bra adesoa yi 
Mehia sɛ me twere wo ahoɔden.

Ka me ho ‘wura 
Na sɛ amaneɛ bɛn a 
Na sɔhwɛ ahum tu fa me tiri so a 
Anaa nsuo yiri twa me ho hyia mpo a 
Hwee rennyɛ me, na mekoma mmɔ hu.

Ka me ho ‘wura 
Akyɛdeɛ anaa nhyira bi 
Ɛnntumi nkyɛn deɛ wode ama me yi 
Na menim sɛ wo ka me ho daa nyinaa 
Metenka baabi’ a me wɔ sɛ wobɛn.

Ka me ho ‘wura 
Sɛ menni obi mpo a 
Sɛ ɛba sɛ me su wɔ yea mu a 
Na me merɛ a mɛfi asaase yi so du a 
O mesrɛ sɛ Awurade, ka me ho.

Ɔdɔ adi adwuma no 
Wako adi nnim koraa 
Ɔbo awɛmfoɔ ayɛ kwa 
Kristo afi awufoɔm.

Y’anuonyam Hene te ase 
Owuo wo bɔre wɔ he? 
Ɔwuu prɛko, gyee yɛn kra 
Damoa, wo nkonim wɔ hen?

Woakrɔn Kristo wɔ ɛsoro 
Yedi N’akyi rekɔ hɔ 
Yɛte sɛ No yɛasɔre 
Asɛnnua ne soro yɛn dea.

Teɛm denden ka asɛm no ma obiara nte 
Trɛ nsɛmpa no mu wɔ wiase nyinaa 
Trɛ anigyeɛ nsɛm no mu nea nnipa wɔ 
Obiara a ɔpɛ no mmra.

Obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔba no nyɛ ntɛm 
W’abue pon n’ano, fawo pɛ hyɛn mu 
Yesu ne nokorɛ nkwa ne kwan mu 
Obiara a ɔpɛ no mmra.

Obiara a ɔpɛ no bɔhyɛ no yɛ ne de 
Obiara a ɔpɛ bɛtena hɔ daa 
Obiara a ɔpɛ benya nkwa afebɔɔ 
Obiara a ɔpɛ no mmra.

content.chorus:

Meyɛ Wode, Nyame mate wo nne

hymns.title: Metwere basa a ɛnwu da no

verses.verse_content:
‘Yɔnkofa bɛn ni, anigye kronkron 
Metwere basa a ɛnwu da no 
Nhyira bɛn ni asomdwoe bɛn ni 
Metwere basa a ɛnwu da no.

Akwantu yi mu nanteɛ ayɛ dɛ 
Metwere basa a ɛnwu da no. 
O hwɛ sɛ me kwan no mu hyerɛn daa 
Metwere basa a ɛnwu da no.

Deɛn na ɛhuna me, deɛn na mesuro? 
Metwere basa a ɛnwu da no. 
Me wura bɛn me yi menya asomndwoe

verses.verse_content:

Ɛhɔ nhwiren kyɛn Eden de

Yerusalem m’ ahotɔ fie

Adamfo bi nni hɔ sɛ Yesu no

Bi nni hɔ, bi nni hɔ 
Anaa wangye ɔbɔnefoɔ bi pɛn

verses.verse_content:

Mekyerɛ wɔn a wɔayera, akra a wɔayɛ merɛ 
Me wura pirafoɔ Yesu nkyɛn kwan 
Mɛdi wɔn anim nkwagye kwan so 
Makyerɛ wɔn kwan akɔ daa nkwaa mu.

Saa na mɛtu ahumɔbɔ kwan no 
Dabiara mɛdi Kristo akyi

Mɛkyerɛ ayarefoɔ Yesu, ɛkwan no.

hymns.title: SIESIE WO HO HYIA WO NYAME

verses.verse_content:
Howhini wo da kyinkyin Wayera afi 
Nyame nnwan mu 
Ɛnti wo nte ne frɛ yi 
Yɛ ahoboa hyia wo Nyame

Adɛn na wonni botae bi’aa 
Bere a wo nkwanna retwan

Yɛ ahoboa hyia wo Nyame

Ɛnti wo nte wo nnamfo a 
Wɔdɔ wo no adesrɛ yi

Sɛ wo po nsa tofrɛ yi 
Na woma Honhom no kɔ a

Sɛ wontumi nhyia Nyame

verses.verse_content:

Awerɛhoɔ ama wo ayɛ hoyaa

O nkwa ne animuonyam wura

Asɛm bɛn mpo na mɛfɛm

Ma wo da biara da.

hymns.title: Hwan na ɔgyina me pono akyi

verses.verse_content:

Me pagyafoɔ mahweaseɛ mu 
Nkwa mu o ‘wuo mu o me bribiara 
Ne Yesu anwanwa dɔ yi.

content.chorus:
Anwanwa dɔ Anwanwa dɔ 
Yesu anwanwa dɔ yi.

verses.verse_content: Mene bobe no, mo ne ɛmam no Monso aba pa ma Yesu ɛnnɛ Man a ɛnso aba pa no wɔ ne mu so Yesu aka sɛ ɔbɛtwa afi hɔ.
Nsɛm a maka no ama mo ho atɔ Motena me mu a mobɛ so aba pii Mɛdi me bo so na matena mo mu Na me ne wo akyɛ soro anuonyam.
Mo aba na wiasefoɔ de behu mo Mo nante dɔ mu sɛ adekyee mma Mo kwankyerɛfoɔ no retwan wɔ mo anim Moni n’ akyi nkɔ anuonyam mu

content.chorus: Mene bobe no, mo ne ɛman no Mene bobe no, moni nokware Deɛ mo bisa bi’ a ɔde bɛma mo Agya no dɔ me na menso dɔ mo

hymns.title: Den na menfa yi wo aye

verses.verse_content:
Dɛn na menfa nyi wo ayɛ 
Tumi wura dasebrɛ 
Fa wo honhom pa no ma me 
Na m’asɛm ayɛ wo fɛ 
Na wo dɔ nsɛnkyerɛne 
Na wo dom no tra m’adwen, 
Tumfoɔ ne ɔhene kɛseɛ 
Yɛda w’ase yi w’ayɛ

Sɛ mekae me bɔne kwan a 
Mebobɔ mu ka pii no a 
Ɛma me fɛre me tirim daa 
Sɛ wo hwɛ me so ara 
Na wo kura me hiani 
Na wo yɛ timɔbɔ ma me 
Tumfoɔ ne ɔhene kɛse 
Yɛda w’ase yi w’ayɛ

Tie, mete Odwanhwɛfoɔ no nne 
Fi srɛ so ɔyea sum no mu 
Refrɛ nwanmaa a w’ayera 
Fi Odwanhwɛfoɔ ban no mu

Hwan bɛkɔ Odwanhwɛfoɔ yi mmoa? Akɔhweheɛ nnwanmaa no 
Na ɔde akobɔfo aba fie? 
Akata wɔn so awɔ no mu?

Tie wɔn su firi srɛ no so 
Fi bepɔ no atifi hɔ 
Tie owura no rese wo sɛ 
Kɔhwehwɛ me nnwan maa nea wɔ wɔ

content.chorus:
Fa wɔn bram , fa wɔn bra 
Fa wɔn fi bɔne no mu bra 
Fa wɔn bra, fa wɔn bra 
Fa akobɔfoɔ brɛ Yesu.

verses.verse_content:
Obi nyaa ɔpɛ sɛ ɔbɛwu ama me 
Na mekra ɛnfra yi anya nkwa 
Ɔpɛɛ sɛ ɔbɛtu asɛnnua ho kwan no 
Na ɔde me bɔne akyɛ me.

Ɔwɔ dɔ ne ahobrɛase, ɔsi me ho aboterɛ 
Berɛ a ɔyi me komam ɛfii no 
Afɔbuo bi nni me so na me de me ho 
Fisɛ wabɔ me bɔne nyinaa asɛndua mu.

Mɛfam Agyenkwa no ho, mentwe me ho da 
Mede anigye bɛtu me kwan no 
M’ano fafa bɛto dwom, me koma bɛto dwom 
Sɛ w’ayi me bɔne nyinaa afi ho.

content.chorus:
Ɔde abɔ asɛndua no so
 O ɔpɛɛ sɛ ɔbɛsoa ne nyinaa 
Awerɛhoɔ ne yea mu 
Yesu kɔɔ asɛndua ho 
Na ɔsoaa me bɔne de kɔɔ hɔ.

verses.verse_content:
Sɛ mɛyɛ sɛ wo o gyefoɔ hyirafoɔ 
Ɛyi ne me daa ‘pɛ ne adesrɛ 
Mede anigye bɛpo wiase ahonya 
Yesu na mayɛ pɛ sɛ wo ara.

Sɛ mɛyɛ sɛ wo ayamhyehyeɛ mu 
Bɔnefafiri ne ayamye mu 
Mɛboa onubie, deɛ w’atɔ baha 
Mahwehwɛ ‘bɔnefoɔ akobɔfoɔ.

Sɛ mɛyɛ sɛ wo ahobrease mu 
Mayɛ konkron adwo akokoɔdurom’ 
Matumi agye animka bi ara 
Mahu amane agye ebinom.

Sɛ mɛyɛ sɛ wo mewura mereba 
Abɛgye abodin kronkron no 
Mede deɛ mewɔ nyinaa are reba 
Awurade ne nyinaa yɛ wo deɛ afei.

content.chorus:
Sɛ mɛyɛ sɛ wo, sɛ mɛ yɛ sɛ wo 
Gyefoɔ hyirafoɔ, wo ahoteɛ mu 
Bra woahoɛfɛ mu, bra wo mayɛ mu 
Fa wo suban no hyɛ me komam’

hymns.title: EPONO NO ANO DA HO MA ME

verses.verse_content:
Ɛpon’ bi wabue ato hɔ 
Na hann bi fi asɛndua ho 
Gyegye n’ akwan no mu hyenhyɛn 
Yi gyefoɔ no dɔ adi.

Ɛpo’ no da hɔ ma nnipa a 
Wɔhyɛn mu hwehwɛ nkwagye
Adefoɔ ne ahiafoɔ 
Aberempɔn ne ahohwifoɔ.

Sɛ atanfo muna mpo a pem so 
Ber’ a adom pono no ano da hɔ yi 
Soa asɛndua kɔnya ahenkyɛ 
Ɔdɔ ho daa adanseɛ.

Yɛdu asuogya no ho a 
Yɛ bɛ soɛ asɛndua no 
Na yɛakɔfa ahenkyɛ no 
Na yɛadɔ no soro akyɛ so.

content.chorus:
Ao ahumɔbɔ abun no ni
ɔbuee pon no too hɔ maa me
Maa me! Maa me!
ɔbuee too hɔ maa me.

verses.verse_content:
Nyame yeyi w’ ayɛ 
Wo dɔba no nti 
Yesu a owui na ɔkɔ soro hɔ

Nyame yeyi w’ ayɛ 
Wo hann honhom no a 
Wakyerɛ yɛn Agyenkwa 
Na ayi yɛn sum no.

‘Nuonyam ayɛyi 
Nka adwamma a owui 
Wasa yɛn bɔne 
Na wayi yɛn fi nyinaa.

Nuonyam ayɛyi 
Nka Adam Nyankopɔn
A watɔ yɛn 
Ahwehwɛ Akyerɛ yɛn kwan.

content.chorus:
Alleluya ‘nuonyam nka wo 
Alleluya Amen 
Alleluya ‘nuonyam nka wo 
Kanyan yɛn bio.

verses.verse_content:
Sɛ yɛn kwan no mu 
Taa yɛ hu’ sɛn ara a 
Yɛbɛhu’ yɛn hene da bi 
Saa anɔpa no munumkum bɛfi hɔ 
Yɛbɛhu’ yɛn hene da bi.

Yea ne awerɛhoɔ akyi 
Berɛ ne amaneɛ akyi 
Yɛbɛhu yɛn hene da bi 
Daa nkwa no mu 
Yɛbɛkyɛ anigyeɛ ne nhyira 
Yɛbɛhu’ yɛn hene da bi

Sɛ yɛdi atamfoɔ so 
Na yɛdi nkonim a 
Yɛbɛhu’ yɛn hene da bi 
Sɛ yɛn brɛ yi twa mu 
Na owia tɔ a 
Yɛbɛhu’ yɛn hene da bi.

content.chorus:
Yɛbɛhu’ yɛn hene da bi 
Yɛbɛteam ato ‘dwom da bi 
Yɛbɛhyia n’ anim 
Na ɔbɛfrɛ ne mma 
Yɛbɛhu yɛn hene da bi.

verses.verse_content:
Yɛtaa ba bɛhyia mu 
Yɛ to nnwom bɔ mpae 
Yɛde yɛ’ afɔdeɛ ba 
Saa da kronkron yi mu.

Deɛ woaka nyinaa ara 
Ɛnka yɛadwene mu 
Na yɛnsom wo yiye 
Sɛ yɛdi paano no a.

Ma yɛn nyinaa nya adwen koro 
Wɔ wo honhom mu 
Mfa nhyira kuruwa yi a 
Awurade de ama no.

content.chorus:
Yɛ yɛadom, yɛnhunu wo dɔ 
Na yɛn nsom wo nokorɛ ne kronkron mu.

verses.verse_content:
Yesu m’ Agyenkwa no baa Betelhem 
Wɔwoo N’ mmoa ‘didiɛ maa yaw ne fɛre 
O ɛyɛ nwanwa, nhyira nka ne din 
Ɔbae bɛhwehwɛɛ me 
Ɔbae bɛhwehwɛɛ me 
Ɔbae bɛhwehwɛɛ me 
O ɛyɛ nwanaw, nhyira nka ne din 
Ɔbae bɛhwehwɛɛ me.

Yesu m’ Agyenkwa, ahummɔbɔ ne adom 
Fi ne die wɔ ɛsoro no mu bae 
Ɔresrɛ ma abɔnefoɔ te sɛ me 
Ɔbae bɛsrɛ maa me 
Ɔbae bɛsrɛ maa me 
Ɔbae bɛsrɛ maa me 
Ɔsesrɛ ma abɔnefoɔ te sɛ me 
Ɔbae bɛsrɛ maa me

Yesu m’ Agyenkwa Tetekwaframoa 
Bre a meyerae fii ne nnwankuo no mu no 
Ɔne mekra kasaa bɔkɔɔ kyɛe yie 
Ɔbae, bɛfrɛɛ me 
Ɔbae , bɛfrɛɛ me 
Ɔbae, bɛfrɛɛ me 
Ɔne mekra kasae bɔkɔɔ kyɛe yie 
Ɔbae, bɛfrɛɛ me.

Yesu m’ Agyenkwa fi soro bɛba bio 
Ne bɔhyɛ yɛ dɛ ɔbra nna yi mu 
O mehu no sɛ ofi wiem resian 
Reba abɛfa me 
Ɔreba abɛfa me 
Ɔreba abɛfa me 
Omehu no sɛ ofi wim resian 
Reba abɛfa me.

hymns.title: SEDEE YESU DIN SI YE DE

verses.verse_content:
Sɛdeɛ Yesu din si yɛ dɛ 
Wɔ gyedini asom 
Etu ne yea sa ne yare 
Etu ne suro nyinaa.

Ɛbɔ honhom pirafoɔ asu 
Ɛdwo koma a abrɛ 
Aduane ma honhom a ɛkɔm de n 
Ahomgye ma berɛfoɔ.

Me mmɔdenmmɔ ayɛ mmerɛ 
M’ahokekaa yɛ adwo 
Na bere a mehu sedeɛ Woteɛ 
Meyi wo ayɛ sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ.

Kyerɛ da n’ na maka Wo dɔ no 
Mede nkwahwea biara 
Ma Wo din ho nnwom a ɛyɛ dɛ 
Ndwodwo me kra wo wuom.

Mehia Yesu, mehia a mepae mu ka 
Yɔnko bi nni hɔ sɛno ahokyerɛ mu 
Mehia Yesu, hia a mede anigye di 
Ɛbinom nko soa wɔ’adesoa mpo a 
Mehia Yesu.

Mehia Yesu, mehia yɔnko sɛ ‘no 
Akyerɛ me kwan 
Sɛ ɔbra kwan u duru sum a 
Mehia Yesu, sɛ atamfo ba me so 
Menim sɛ me nko ntumi nyinaa 
Nti mehia Yesu.

Mehia Yesu, mehia no kɔ awieɛ 
Obi nsɛ no abɔnefoɔ yɔnko 
Mehia Yesu, mempɛ yɔnko foforɔ 
Ɔyɛ ayamyɛ, ɔdi nokorɛ 
Yiw mehia Yesu.

content.chorus:
Mehia Yesu, Mehia Yesu, 
Mehia Yesu, dabiara 
Mehia no wɔ merɛ, pa mu 
Mehia no sɛ ahumtu a 
Dabiara wɔ m’abrabɔ m’ Yiw, mehia Yesu.

verses.verse_content:
Nyame abusua ne n’asɔre kronkron 
Ɔde ne nyansa n’ɛtee, hyɛ ne den 
Dwanekɔbea ma mpanyin, mɔfra
Ne mu na nokwasɛm fi kɔ.

Wɔn a wɔadi wuo so no wɔ nohoaa. 
Agyedifo nso te ase ha 
Nkurofoɔ kuo baanu yi bom yɛ 
Fie baako awoɔ kronkron mu.

Ɛhɔ animuonyam, ɛha nhyira 
Anidasoɔ koro ‘wurade din mu
Asafo koro ne nkyerɛkyerɛ koro 
N’aba tennenee hyira aman nyinaa.

content.chorus:
Kristo asafo
Ɔde ne mogya atɔ no aboɔden 
Nyame ahennie hotefoɔ tenabea 
Nkwa ahenman ma Nyankopɔn mma.

verses.verse_content:
Yesu frɛ yɛn wɔ bere a 
Ɔbra asorɔkye bɔ yɛn 
Ne nne dɛɛdɛ gyegye daadaa 
Sɛ kristoni di ma kyi.

Tetemerɛ mu asomafo 
Tee wɔ Galilee po so n’ 
Wɔgyaa abusua, ne ne adwuma 
Kɔdii wɔn dɔfo n’akyi

Yesu frɛ yɛn sɛ mma yɛnnsom 
Wiase mu neɛma buhuo 
Ɔhwɛ neɛma ɛsom yɛn bo ka 
Sɛ Kristoni dɔ m’ kyɛn eyi.

Anigye ne awerɛho mu ‘
Dwumaden ne ahomegye mu 
Ɔda so frɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnnɔ 
No ɛnkyɛn ade nyinaa.

Yesu frɛ yɛn: O Agyenkwa 
Yɛserɛ ma yɛnte wo frɛ no 
Yɛn koma nyɛ setie ma wo 
Yɛnnɔ wo nkyɛn ade nyinaa.

Adom nwanwa, ne dɛ a ɛyɛ 
Ɛgyee me mɔborɔni 
Anka na mayera afei wahu me 
M’anifurae afei me hu ade.

Adom n’ɛkyerɛ mekoma suro 
N’adom n’ɛyii me suro 
Berɛ a me yɛɛ setie maa asɛm no 
Adom no pue’ maa me.

Mefaa ‘haw ne amaneɛ mu 
Ansa na meduu ha 
Adom n’ɛdee me duu ha dwoodwoo 
Na ɛbɛdi manim akɔ fie.

Awurade de papa ahyɛ me bɔ 
N’asɛm ma manidasoɔ tim 
Ɔbɛyɛ me kyɛm ne kyɛfa 
Meda so te nkwam’ yi.

Sɛ yɛtena hɔ mfeɛ mpendu a 
Owia bɛka so ahyerɛn 
Yɛbɛkɔso ayi Nyame ayɛ 
Te sɛ yɛhyɛɛ ase no.

O me Nyame, sɛ mede ahodwiri dwene 
Wiase nyinaa a wode wo nsa ayɛ a 
Mehu nsoroma, mete agradaa huuhuu 
Wotumi da adi wo wiase nyinaa.

Sɛ me nante kwaeɛ ne mfofoo mu a 
Na mete nomaa to wɔn nnwom dɛɛdɛ 
Na meto man fi mepɔ atifi a 
Mete nsuo a ɛworoso ne mframa dɛɛdɛ.

Na sɛ medwene sɛ Nyame ankame ne ba 
Na ɔsomaa no maa no ba bɛwui 
Asɛndua so, ɔsoaa m’adesoa anigyem’ 
Ɔtuu mogya, wui de yii me bɔne.

Sɛ Kristo ba wɔ osebɔ denden mu a, 
Abɛfa me a mɛnya anigye kɛse 
Hɔ na mɛkoto ahobreaseɛ ne ayɛyie m’ 
Na m’ateam sɛ me Nyame wo yɛ kɛse.

content.chorus:
Me kra to dwom ma wo me Nyamkopɔn 
Woyɛ kɛse, wo yɛ kɛse, 
Me kra to dwom ma wo me 
Nyamkopɔn Woyɛ kɛse, wo yɛ kɛse.

verses.verse_content:
Enti menkɔ no nsapan 
De saa akɔhyia me Gyefo? 
Me ‘nyi da koro mpo mfa nsom no 
Me nya hwee ngu nan ase?

O anka metumi anya 
Nna a mɛsɛe no bɔne mu no. 
Anka mede bɛma m’ Agyenkwa 
Na mayɛ ne pɛ anigyem.

Ahotefo monkeka mo ho 
Nsɔre nyɛ ‘dwuma adekyeɛ mu 
Anhwɛ a owuo anadwo abɛtro mo 
Monye akra bere a motumi yi

content.chorus:
Enti menkɔ no nsapan 
Menfa saa nhyia m’ Agyenkwa? 
Me ‘nya ɔkra baako mpo nkyea no 
Enti menkɔ no nsapan?

hymns.title: O mewura ma me ne wo nante

verses.verse_content:
O mewura wo ne me nante 
Ahobreaseɛ ne ɔsom mu 
Ka woahuntasɛm kyerɛ me 
Boa me na me nsoa ɔbra yi mu brɛ.

Boa me na menfa ‘dɔ asɛm bi 
Ntwe wɔn a w’akoma ayɛ duru 
Ma mensɔ akobɔfoɔ mu 
Na menkyerɛ wɔn efie kwan.

Kyerɛ me woaboterɛ na ne 
Me nante ayɔnkofa pa mu 
‘Dwuma a ɛma gyedie yɛ den 
Awerɛhyem a edi bɔne so.

Anidasoɔ a ɛdi ne hann 
Hyerɛn daakye kwan kɛse no mu 
Asomdwoe a wo nko de ma 
O me wura ma me ne wo ntena.

Sɛ ɔbra asorɔkye rebɔ wo akɔ a 
Na woaba mu bu 
Redwen sɛ biribi a ayera a 
Kan wo nhyira pii no to din nkoro nkoro 
Na deɛ Awurade ayɛ ama wo Bɛyɛ wo nwanwa.

Sɛ ɔbra adwendwen ayɛ wo adesoa a 
Na asɛnnua a ɛso wo no mu ayɛ duru 
Kan wo nhyira pii no na akyinyi nyinaa bɛkɔ 
Na woani bɛgye ɛna retwam yi,

Sɛ wohwɛ ɛbinom a wɔnya wɔnb ho a 
Dwen sɛ Kristo de ahonya a ɛkyɛn so ahyɛ wo bɔ 
Kan wo nhyira pii a sika ntumi ntɔ 
Wo akatua ne wofie a ɛwɔ soro hɔ.

Ɛnti sɛ ɔhaw no mu yɛ den sɛn ara 
Nya abotɔyam Nyame no a bɛkyerɛ 
Kan wo nhyira pii no na abɔfo bɛtie 
Ɛbɛma wo awerɛkyekye akwantu yi mu.

content.chorus:
Kan wo nhyira, to din nkoro nkoro 
Kan wo nhyira, hwɛ deɛ Nyame ayɛ 
Kan wo nhyira, to din nkoro nkoro 
Kan wo nhyira dodoɔ 
Hwɛ deɛ Nyame ayɛ.

verses.verse_content:
Wɔ Nyame y’ Agyenkwa dɔ m’ 
Bribi ‘a bɛ yɛ yie 
N’adɔeɛ nsesa, ɔde kyɛ 
Ne nyinaa yɛ. 
Mogya a ‘som bo sa yɛn yadeɛ 
Adom a ‘yɛ pɛ afrɛ yɛn 
Nsa a ‘yɛ den bɔ yɛn ho ban 
Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ yie.

Sɛ yɛ fa amanahunu mu mpo a 
Bribi’ a bɛ yɛ yie 
Yɛ wɔ nkwagye a ɛyɛ pɛ 
Ne nyinaa yɛ Yɛ’ anigye sɛ yɛtwere 
Nyame a Yɛ so aba yɛ tena 
Kristo mu a Honhom no di yɛ anim kɔ ahoteɛm’ 
‘Sɛ sɛ ɛyɛ yie.

Yɛrehwɛ ‘nna pa anim 
Bribi’ a bɛ yɛ yie
 Gyedie tumi fa awerɛhoɔ m’ 
Ne nyinaa yɛ 
Yɛtwere yɛn Agya no dɔ 
Yesu ma yɛn bribi’ a yɛhia 
Nkwa mu o owuo mu mpo 
Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ yie.

hymns.title: Se medwen asennua nwanwa no a

verses.verse_content:
Sε medwen Asennua nwanwa a 
Nuonyam Hene wuu so no ho a 
Memmu m’adepa biara hwεε 
Na mahomaso yε me tan.

Awurade mma mennhoran 
Gyesε Kristo me Nyame wuo m’ 
Nneεma hunu a mεdↄ no 
Mede bↄ afↄdeε Ne mogya m’.

Hwε sε yea ne ↄdↄ resen 
Ne ti, Ne nsa, ne Ne nan ho 
Saa dↄ ne yea yi mmↄ mu pεn 
Na nsↄe kyε yi wↄnsoaa bi da.

Wiase nyinaa yε me de po a 
Anka εyε akyεdeε a εsua 
Anwanwa dↄ, Nyame dↄ yi 
Gye kra, nkwa, ade nyinaa.

Gyefoɔ Yesu kyerɛ me kwan 
Ɔbra ahum po no so 
Asorɔkye adi m’ anim 
Abotan ahunta me 
Ɔkwankyerɛfo ne wo 
Gyefoɔ Yesu kyerɛ me kwan.

Sɛ ɛna kyɛ ne ba so no 
Wo tumi hyɛ po no so; 
Asorɔkye mpo tie wo nne 
Sɛ wo see wɔn sɛ yɛ komm 
Po so tumifoɔ nwanwani 
Gyefoɔ Yesu kyerɛ me kwan.

Awie n’ me bɛn mpano hɔ a 
Na ɔsɛefoɔ bobɔm a 
Me ne ɔhomɛe ntam no 
Ber’ a metwere Wo kokom 
Mɛte Wo ne a ɛse: ‘’
Nsuro mɛkyerɛ wo kwan.’’

Bra Agyenkwa hɔ, nkyɛ koraa 
W’ akyerɛ yɛn kwan wɔ 
N’ asɛm mu ha 
Ogyina yɛn mfinimfini ha nnɛ 
Reka no brɛɛ sɛ bra.

Bra Agyenkwa hɔ, tie ne nne 
Koma nyinaa nni ahurusie 
Na yɛnfa No nyɛ yɛn fam deɛ 
Monnkyɛ koraa, mo mmra.

Dwen prɛko bio, sɛ ɔwɔ ha nnɛ 
Bu ne nhyira frɛ no bi na di so 
Tie N’ awɔse nne rewoso sɛ 
Bra Agyenkwa hɔ, bra.

content.chorus:
Nhyiamu no bɛyɛ anigye 
Da a yɛn koma befi bɔne ho 
Na yɛne wo Agyenkwa bɛtena 
Yɛn daa fie no mu.

verses.verse_content:
Ao me nkurofo monhwɛ frankaa 
No renyam wɔ soro 
Afei nkyidɔm reyi wɔnho 
Nkonim abɛn.

Hwɛ dɔm kɛse bi a wɔreba 
Bonsam di wɔn anim 
Akatakyie rehwe ase 
Mmarima bo retu.

Hwɛ nkonim frakaa no renyam 
Tie abɛn rehyɛn 
Yɛbɛdi nim, yɛn hene din mu 
Atamfo nyinaa so.

Ɔko no akyɛ na emu ayɛ den 
Nso yɛn moa rebɛn 
Yɛn sahene kɛse no reba 
Me nua nya akomato m’

content.chorus:
Monyina ɔko n’ano na me’eba 
Yesu renyam nsa 
Mo nye so ase no soro hɔ sɛ 
Woadom nti yɛ gyina.

hymns.title: Tete Bo a wopae maa me

verses.verse_content:
Tete bo a wↄpae mma me

Sε me nisuo sen daa po

εntumi bↄne ka tua 
gyefoↄ ne Wo ara nko

hymns.title: HWEE NNI HO SE YESU MOGYA

verses.verse_content:
Deɛn na ɛbɛhoro me bɔne? 
Hwee nni hɔ sɛ Yesu mogya 
Deɛn bɛma m’ adi mu bio? 
Hwee nni hɔ sɛ Yesu mogya.

Sɛ mepɛ bɔne fafiri 
Hwee nni hɔ sɛ Yesu mogya. 
Sɛ mepɛ ahoteɛ nso a 
Hwee ni hɔ sɛ Yesu mogya

Hwee ntumi ntua bɔne ka 
Hwee nni hɔ sɛ Yesu mogya 
Ɛnyɛ papa bi a m’ayɛ 
Hwee ni hɔ sɛ Yesu mogya.

M’ asomdwoe, anidasoɔ ni 
Hwee nni hɔ sɛ Yesu mogya 
Me tenenee nyinaa nso ni 
Hwee nni hɔsɛ Yesu mogya.

content.chorus:
O mogya a ɛdi mu 
Ɛte me ho fitaa 
Me nnim asuti bi 
Hwee nni hɔ sɛ Yesu mogya.

verses.verse_content:
Mereba w’asɛndua ase 
Meyɛ furaefoɔ mmɔbɔrɔni 
Me bu ade nyinaa hunu 
Mɛnya nkwahosan wɔ hɔ

M’akoma fee wo akyɛ 
Bɔne adi mu hene akyɛ 
Wo nsɛmpa aba me hɔ sɛ 
Mɛhoro wo ho bɔne nyinaa

Mede m’ade nyinaa ma wo 
Honam mu ade nyinaa 
Me kra ne me nipadua 
Ɛnyɛ wo dea daa nyinaa.

Me gye w’adom anigyeɛ 
m’ Me de anigyeɛ tie w’ asɛm 
Me gye wo bɔhyɛ nyinaa 
O m’ Awurade, m’Awurade.

content.chorus:
Awurade me twere wo
O Kalvary Adwamaa
Me koto w’asεndua ase
Me hwehwε wo nkwagyeε no.

verses.verse_content:
Ɔbra yi brɛ ne abɛbrɛsɛ yi mu 
So ɛyɛ, so ɛyɛ ma wo kra 
Woabu wo bra yie sɛ so wu anadwo yi? 
So ɛyɛ, so ɛyɛ ma wo kra?

Wo ho bɔne asa, na woakomam’ te? 
So ɛyɛ, so ɛyɛ ma wo kra? 
Wo wɔ deɛ wɔbɔ n’ asɛnnuam no afa 
So ɛyɛ, so ɛyɛ ma wo ka?

Woyi ɔsoroni no dɔ no ayɛ 
So ɛyɛ, so ɛyɛ ma wo kra 
Wobenya ahenkyɛ ne Awurade amo 
So ɛyɛ, so ɛyɛ ma wo kra?

content.chorus:
So ɛyɛ, so ɛyɛ 
Ma wo kra, ma wo kra 
Wode wo ho anigyeɛm 
Wobu wo bra yie sɛ wu anadwo yi? 
So ɛyɛ, so ɛyɛ ma wo kra?

verses.verse_content:
Deε mete yi menni hwee ka

Ↄko ne suro ahyε me ma 
Na akyinnyi him me po a 
Nyame Adwamma m’aba.

Deε mete yi me yε mmↄbↄ 
Anite, ahonya ne ayaresa 
Deε mehwehwε nyinaa fi wo hↄ 
Nyame Adwamma m’aba.

Deε mete yi Wobεgye me

Megye W’anosεm medi nti 
Nyame Adwamma m’aba.

Si so to kyerɛ me bio

Nkwasɛm a ɛyɛ nwanwa.

content.chorus:
